app_archetype: High-Accessibility Multimodal AI Learning Companion for Low-Vision Middle Schoolers (11-14)
target_audience: Children aged 11-14 with weak eyesight / visual fatigue who need voice-first and large-print multimodal learning in Azerbaijani and Turkish, parents wanting to scan school books easily
design_philosophy: WARM SENSORY CLARITY (Nordic tactile paper warmth + German optical precision + joyful storytelling). Anti-AI-slop: zero generic neon purple gradients, no tiny unreadable grey fonts. Every element has tactile solid contrast, 48px+ touch targets, 18px-32px fluid readable fonts, clear high-contrast borders, natural audio waveforms, and instant bilingual toggle (AZ / TR).

supported_modes.name: Ilıq Kağız (Göz Qoruyucu)
supported_modes.description: Warm parchment off-white, deep warm charcoal text (prevents glare and photophobia)

supported_modes.name: Gecə Kəhrəbası (Yüksək Kontrast)
supported_modes.description: Deep obsidian ground with soft warm amber / gold text for photophobic eyes

supported_modes.name: Sarı & Qara (Maksimum Kontrast)
supported_modes.description: Certified low-vision contrast: vivid educational yellow on pitch black

scale_settings.line_height_rule: Minimum 1.6 to 1.8 line height for body text to prevent visual line crowding
scale_settings.letter_spacing_rule: tracking-wide or tracking-normal (never tracking-tighter on small text)

accessibility_rules.contrast_target: WCAG AAA 7:1 for main body text, 4.5:1 minimum for secondary labels
accessibility_rules.tts_read_aloud_protocol: Every AI response box MUST have a prominent, 1-click 'Səsləndir' (Listen / Play) button with speed toggle (0.8x, 1.0x, 1.2x) and sentence-level animated reading highlight
accessibility_rules.voice_input_protocol: Large, vibrating mic button with clear 'Dinləyirəm...' (Listening...) pulse state, visual soundwave indicator, and instant fallback speech recognition + manual text box
accessibility_rules.language_toggle: Instant 1-click switch between 'Azərbaycan dili' and 'Türkçe' with localized UI text, voice prompts, and middle-school terminology
accessibility_rules.pdf_scan_experience: Drag-and-drop or file upload for PDF books and chapter scans, with instant chapter detection, audio summary generation, and key questions

key_components.name: AccessiblityTopBar
key_components.description: Sticky accessible header with quick font size stepper (A-, A+), high-contrast theme picker (Parchment, Amber Night, Yellow/Black), Language switcher (AZ / TR), and Audio Speed control.

key_components.name: TutorHeroCompanion
key_components.description: Welcoming, warm AI companion widget ('Ağıllı Müəllim' / 'Dost Canlısı Müəllim') with speaking animated avatar, live status, and one-touch big audio prompt.

key_components.name: InteractiveVoiceChat
key_components.description: Central conversation space with oversized message bubbles, high-contrast text, word-by-word or sentence read-aloud TTS buttons, repeat button, and massive microphone input with soundwave feedback.

key_components.name: BookScannerLibrary
key_components.description: PDF Book upload/scanner section with pre-loaded middle-school curriculum books (Biologiya 6-cı sinif, Təbiət elmləri, Riyaziyyat, Tarix), chapter selector, and 1-click 'İzah Et və Oxu' (Explain & Read Aloud) feature.

key_components.name: TopicSimplifierCard
key_components.description: Simplifies difficult school concepts into 3 bullet points with analogies suited for an 11-14 year old, plus interactive quiz with big buttons and celebratory audio feedback.

key_components.name: MagnifierReadingSheet
key_components.description: Dedicated distraction-free reading mode with huge text (up to 36px), sentence highlighter, play/pause TTS scrubber, and ruler/focus strip for weak eyesight.

mock_and_integration_notes.tts_engine: Native Web SpeechSynthesis API with natural fallbacks (az-AZ, tr-TR, and en fallback), plus realistic animated audio wave bars and live sentence tracker.
mock_and_integration_notes.stt_engine: Web SpeechRecognition (webkitSpeechRecognition) with instant mic feedback, plus simulated pre-built voice queries in Azerbaijani and Turkish.
mock_and_integration_notes.pdf_analysis: Client-side PDF text extraction and mock middle-school curricula parser (with 4 pre-loaded textbooks: Hüceyrə və Canlılar / Canlıların Dünyası, Günəş Sistemi, Kəsrlər və Faizlər, Qədim Şumer Mədəniyyəti) and dynamic file upload handler for custom PDFs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Import Lexend and Outfit Google fonts in index.css so typography is optimized for dyslexia and low-vision readers.
Ensure every single interactive element has a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.
Do NOT use small 12px or 14px text anywhere. Minimum font size in standard mode is 18px-20px.
Buttons must have a minimum height of 48px to 56px with clear 2px to 3px solid borders, thick rounded corners (rounded-2xl), and distinct focus states.
Include both Azerbaijani (Azərbaycan dili) and Turkish (Türkçe) language dictionaries with a 1-click toggle on top.
Provide a realistic, working text-to-speech player with Play, Pause, Speed toggle (0.8x, 1x, 1.2x), and volume control.
Provide an interactive microphone button that captures voice (or falls back gracefully with sample prompts) and submits questions to the AI tutor.
Ensure the PDF upload allows dropping or choosing real PDF files, parses or provides instant accessible breakdown cards with voice read-aloud.
Add a high-contrast mode switcher (Warm Parchment, Amber Night, Yellow/Black high contrast) that instantly transforms the entire UI.
Ensure sonner is integrated for accessible alerts, and no unstyled browser alerts are used.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: DO NOT use dark purple gradients with small white text. Use rich warm parchment (#FAF7F0) or deep obsidian (#0C0A09) with warm amber and deep teal.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.optical_clarity: Borders should be solid and distinct (1.5px to 2.5px), never barely visible faint hairline borders.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.child_tone: Warm, encouraging, enthusiastic, supportive. Middle school appropriate explanations (no dry university jargon, use vivid real-world analogies like comparing a cell nucleus to a school principal or phone CPU).
